name: keyboard-autocorrect
description: iOS-style autocorrect using keyboard-distance-weighted edit distance

autocorrect.dictionaryPaths.description: File paths to newline-delimited word lists (merged with built-in dictionary)

autocorrect.keyboardLayout.description: Keyboard layout: one row per line, characters in physical order

autocorrect.languageIds.description: Language IDs to activate autocorrect on

autocorrect.doublespacePeriod.description: Double-space inserts a period and space (like iOS)

autocorrect.triplespaceComma.description: Triple-space converts the period from double-space into a comma

autocorrect.capitalizeSentence.description: Auto-capitalize first letter of sentences (after . ! ? : and at line start)

autocorrect.predictionEnabled.description: Enable n-gram next-word prediction from corpus files

autocorrect.predictionCorpusPaths.description: File or folder paths to text corpus for building n-gram predictions (supports ${execDir}, ${workspaceFolder}, ~)

autocorrect.predictionMaxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of word predictions to show

enumDescriptions: Low threshold, high costs. Only corrects obvious typos.
Default tuning. Good for general writing.
High threshold, low costs. Catches more, risks more false positives.

autocorrect.suffixesAllow.description: Suffixes that pass through uncorrected when the stem is in the dictionary (e.g. 'starts' = 'start' + 's')

autocorrect.costTransposition.description: (custom only) Cost for adjacent character swaps (e.g. hte→the)

autocorrect.costInsertDelete.description: (custom only) Cost for inserted or deleted characters

autocorrect.costSubstitutionMax.description: (custom only) Max cost for a single key substitution

autocorrect.costLengthPenalty.description: (custom only) Penalty multiplier per character of length difference

autocorrect.lengthFilterMax.description: (custom only) Max character count difference to consider a candidate

autocorrect.thresholdBase.description: (custom only) Minimum distance threshold to accept a correction

autocorrect.thresholdScale.description: (custom only) Threshold scales with word length: max(thresholdBase, length * thresholdScale)

autocorrect.lengthWordMin.description: (custom only) Minimum word length to attempt correction
